gold_rationale: Quantified update interval and operating-mode scope make this a testable software behavior.
Acceptance distance is undefined; no objective pass/fail tolerance can be derived.
Engine-failure trigger exists but the required corrective behavior is unspecified.
Quickly lacks a deadline, dangerous lacks classification, and respond lacks a named action.
Always is broad and its application to safety inhibits is unspecified; does not by itself prove an inconsistency with REQ-015.
Human perception is subjective and no maximum latency is stated.
Whenever possible does not define which losses require which retained functions.
Both are minima. Updating the same field at >=10 Hz also satisfies a >=2 Hz floor. There may be scope ambiguity but no necessary conflict.
Ten parent mission needs are listed, but links from individual SFMC requirements to parents are absent.
Capture/record indicators exist but approval and maintenance cannot be established from this SRS.
Direct examples of documented controls exist, but comprehensiveness of hardware/operator/software safety constraints is unverified.
